retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of a musician with an acoustic guitar, framed by a heavy distressed border and accented with vibrant orange serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic scene featuring a seated man playing an acoustic guitar on a weathered wooden porch, framed by a thick, irregular white distressed border. The composition is anchored by bold, burnt-orange lowercase typography at the top and elegant white serif text at the bottom, separated by a thin horizontal rule.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white subject against a dark, textured background
Vibrant orange typography providing a singular focal point of color
Rough, organic border texture framing the structured architectural lines of the porch
Horizontal rule at the bottom balancing the heavy typographic weight at the top
coreInvariants: Heavy, irregular white distressed border with 'torn paper' texture
Burnt-orange accent color for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is centered horizontally, seated in a tattered armchair, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar and the musician's gaze directed to the left create a strong central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the orange name at the top, moves down to the musician's face, follows his gaze to the guitar, and settles on the white title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas on the left and right of the porch provide depth and focus the viewer on the central figure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photography with a single high-saturation accent in the top-right typography.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly condensed proportions for the top text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' in the top text features a long, elegant descender that breaks the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a bold, colorful modern serif and a delicate, white traditional serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the top display text.
Matches the classic, readable feel of the bottom subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man with curly hair and a beard, wearing a leather jacket, sitting in a tattered armchair on a rustic wooden porch while holding an acoustic guitar. Apply a heavy, irregular white distressed border that looks like torn paper or a chemical photo process.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, burnt-orange serif font in the top right corner using lowercase letters. Add the title in a smaller, white serif font centered at the bottom, also in lowercase, with a thin white horizontal line positioned just below it.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently distressed and irregular?
Is the top text specifically burnt-orange and lowercase?
Is the image strictly black and white except for the orange text?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or logos
Ensure the border is not a clean rectangle
postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text is the only color element.
Verify the border has a 'torn' or 'eroded' appearance.
Ensure the horizontal rule at the bottom is thin and clean.
Confirm all text is lowercase as per the design style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grayscale Portrait + Distressed Border + High-Contrast Serif Typography (Orange/White Split)
